body:
Approved implementation plan (auto-approved gate, epic #99 autonomous run)

Design: new shared module src/global-user-rules.js with upsertGlobalUserRule({domain, decision}) and clearGlobalUserRule(domain) returning HTTP-shaped results; POST/DELETE /api/ui/sites become thin wrappers with identical status codes, bodies, logs and broadcast reasons. Popup routes extracted to src/popup-routes.js (mountPopupRoutes(app, {extensionInstalls, extensionBridge, broadcastUiEvent, port})); POST /api/popup/site-toggle calls upsertGlobalUserRule with the requested action (pure upsert, exactly like the Sites page — no popup-only logic); accepts action or decision; keeps paths, {domain, action}, newState, decision; adds try/catch → 500. _statePillFromPolicy loses the unreachable agent_rule/override branch (state keys: allowed, blocked_user, blocked_global_site_blocklist); /api/popup/state adds currentTab.matchedDomain. Popup client: override pills and dead Agent line removed; labels by state+source ("Allowed (your rule)", "Blocked (your rule)", "Blocked (global block list)"); honors globalTierEnabled (missing → true): disabled toggle + explanation while global rules are off; caption that the pill shows the global policy for this profile; "Rule on <matchedDomain>" line. Wire-compatible both directions. Popup auth loopback gap tracked separately in #110.

Sub-tasks:
- [sub-task 1] Shared global-user-rules module + unit tests (standard)
- [sub-task 2] Extract popup routes, switch both /api/ui/sites call sites, popup-routes HTTP tests, server.js wiring (complex) — after 1
- [sub-task 3] Popup client changes (standard)
- [sub-task 4] CHANGELOG (light)
- [sub-task 5] Verification: server tests, booted-daemon smoke of popup + ui routes, grep, manual popup checklist (standard) — last

DOCS phase for this ticket covers docs/CHROME_EXTENSION.md popup section (pills, state shape, matchedDomain) and MCP_SERVER.md popup paragraphs; the full rewrite stays with #106.
